title: providers.json configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/ai_router/providers.json — pluggable provider declarations. User entries override built-in routes on (provider, model) conflicts. A malformed file is a WARNING (exit code 4 on --json), never a crash: built-in routes keep working.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18321/v1/ (chat/completions and models are appended).

auth.description: none = local servers with no key. A non-local base_url with auth none triggers a loud warning.

api_key.description: Inline key. File is chmod 600 when keys are present.

key_file.description: Path to a file containing the key (alternative to api_key).

models.description: Bare id strings get conservative defaults: quality 2, rpm 30, tier mid.
